{"id":404780,"uuid":"81E6732BC8","title":"Social Media Manager","job_type":"FULLTIME","description":"

Job Title: Social Media Manager

About TerraTern:

TerraTern is one of the fastest-growing Global Talent Mobility Solution providers, dedicated to guiding individuals through seamless international relocation. We offer personalized visa assistance, job search support, and comprehensive resources to empower global aspirants. Our commitment to transparency, expertise, and customer satisfaction ensures a smooth and reliable immigration experience from start to finish.

Role Overview:

We’re looking for a creative, camera-confident Social Media Manager to join our dynamic team. This full-time role combines social media strategy, content creation, influencer collaboration, and on-camera presentation.

You’ll be the driving force behind TerraTern’s online presence - managing our platforms, creating engaging content, representing the brand on camera, and building relationships with influencers who align with our mission.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute data-driven social media and influencer marketing strategies aligned with business goals, with measurable KPIs including growth in followers, engagement, and video reach.

  • Plan, create, and schedule engaging content, posts, reels, stories, and campaigns across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and other platforms—tracking performance against KPIs like conversion and lead generation.

  • Be the on-camera face for videos, reels, and explainers that connect with our audience authentically, contributing to brand consistency and sentiment.

  • Identify, collaborate with, and manage partnerships with influencers, creators, and brand ambassadors in relevant niches (career, education, travel, migration), aiming for high-quality collaborations and measurable ROI.

  • Manage influencer campaigns end-to-end from outreach and negotiation to tracking deliverables and measuring impact, including audience engagement and response rate metrics.

  • Collaborate with content, design, and marketing teams to ensure cohesive storytelling and brand consistency across all channels.

  • Stay updated with social, video, and influencer trends, and apply best practices to increase reach and engagement while monitoring sentiment and awareness KPIs.

  • Track KPIs, prepare monthly performance reports, and derive insights to optimize campaigns—ensuring alignment with business objectives and campaign goals.

  • Engage with our community, respond to comments, DMs, and feedback promptly and professionally, reinforcing brand trust and responsiveness.

  • Translate complex immigration and global mobility topics into relatable, engaging content that resonates with diverse audiences and supports lead generation targets.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in social media management, influencer marketing, or digital content creation.

  • Proven ability to plan and execute influencer collaborations with measurable outcomes.

  • Comfortable and confident appearing on camera for short-form videos, reels, or interviews.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.

  • Proficiency with social media tools (Hootsuite, Buffer, Meta Business Suite, etc.).

  • Creative mindset with a strong sense of design and visual aesthetics.

  • Experience in immigration, study abroad, or global careers (preferred but not mandatory).

Why Join TerraTern?

  • Impactful Work: Help individuals achieve their global career goals and transform their futures.

  • Professional Growth: Learn from experts and stay ahead of industry trends with regular training.

  • Entrepreneurial Culture: Take ownership of your ideas and bring them to life.

  • Collaborative Environment: Join a young, vibrant team that values innovation, learning, and collaboration.

About TerraTern
TerraTern is one of the fastest-growing Global Talent Mobility Solutions, dedicated to guiding clients through seamless relocation journeys. We offer personalized visa assistance, job search support, and comprehensive resources to empower individuals pursuing opportunities abroad. Our commitment to client satisfaction and transparency ensures a smooth, reliable experience at every step of the immigration process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and content gap analysis.
  • Implement on-page SEO, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal linking, and content optimization.
  • Support off-page SEO activities such as link building, outreach, and backlink monitoring.
  • Coordinate with content, development, and marketing teams to improve website performance.
  • Identify SEO opportunities across blogs, landing pages, destination pages, and service pages.
  • Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, leads, and other SEO performance metrics.

  • Track competitors, search trends, algorithm updates, and changing SEO best practices.

  • Good understanding of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.
  • Hands-on experience with keyword research and SEO tools.
  • Basic understanding of Google Analytics, Google Search Console, HTML, and CMS platforms such as WordPress.
  • Strong analytical, writing, communication, and research skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with cross-functional teams.
  • Knowledge of content marketing and local SEO will be an advantage.
  • Experience in EdTech, immigration, study abroad, travel, or B2C businesses is preferred.

Ideal Candidate
A proactive and analytical professional who understands search intent, enjoys working with data and content, and can execute SEO initiatives that improve TerraTern’s online visibility, organic traffic, and business enquiries.

About Terratern
Terratern is the fastest-growing Global Talent Mobility Solution provider, committed to guiding clients through seamless international relocation journeys. Role Overview:

We are looking for a dynamic Business Development Executive to drive our B2C growth initiatives. In this role, you will be at the forefront of engaging with potential clients, understanding their relocation goals, and offering customized solutions aligned with their needs. As a BDE, you will play a critical role in expanding Terratern’s footprint in the global mobility space through strategic outreach and relationship-building.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and engage with prospective clients to generate leads and new business opportunities.

  • Understand clients' relocation requirements and recommend appropriate visa and mobility solutions.

  • Conduct product presentations and consultations to highlight the benefits of Terratern’s offerings.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to tailor services based on individual client needs.

  • Maintain accurate records of leads, interactions, and outcomes using CRM software.

  • Stay informed on global mobility trends, market conditions, and competitors to refine sales strategies.

  • Attend industry events, conferences, and networking forums to strengthen brand presence.

  • Provide clear, accurate information and guide clients toward informed relocation decisions.

  • Achievement of individual sales and revenue targets

  • Lead generation and pipeline development

  • Quality and consistency of CRM data entry and follow-ups

  • Client satisfaction and long-term relationship management

  • Brand visibility and market penetration

Eligibility & Skills

  • 0-1 years of experience in business development, sales, or client acquisition

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills

  • Self-motivated and capable of independently managing a sales pipeline

  • Experience with CRM systems and sales tools

  • Knowledge of immigration or global mobility services is an advantage

  • Proven ability to meet or exceed sales goals

Why Join Terratern?
At Terratern, your work directly impacts lives by helping individuals navigate global relocation with ease. We offer:

  • Impact-Driven Work: Help people achieve their international goals with real-life impact.

  • Learning & Growth: Access ongoing training and insights into immigration trends and business solutions.

  • Ownership & Innovation: Enjoy an entrepreneurial work environment where your ideas are valued.

  • Team Culture: Join a collaborative, energetic team passionate about global mobility.
